---
name: generate-requirements
description: Turn a story into traceable requirements with ambiguities and clarification questions. Use when drafting docs/requirements.md.
---
1. One row per requirement: ID (REQ-F-NNN functional, REQ-N-NNN non-functional), text, and the story acceptance criterion it traces to.
2. Copy acceptance criteria verbatim; list constraints, dependencies and out-of-scope items.
3. Put anything unclear in an Ambiguities table with a proposed default and a numbered question for the human.
4. Mark the file DRAFT until the human approves the `requirements` gate.
